I can’t make repository changes from `/answer`; this route is answer-only. The requested default-model change is feasible, but `ultra` is not a simple `reasoning_effort` value in Sepo today.

Current state:
- Sepo’s Codex default is pinned to `gpt-5.5` in [`.agent/model-defaults.json`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/model-defaults.json#L3-L6).
- The resolver intentionally reads that bundled file offline, not a live model catalog: [`.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.github/actions/resolve-agent-provider/resolve-provider.js#L9-L13).
- Docs and examples also say Codex defaults to `gpt-5.5` and use `xhigh`: [configuration-list.md](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/docs/customization/configuration-list.md#L44-L68).
- The ACPX adapter currently recognizes Codex reasoning suffixes only through `xhigh`, not `max` or `ultra`: [`.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts`](https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/blob/main/.agent/src/acpx-adapter.ts#L97-L99).

Upstream docs now list `gpt-5.6-sol` as the flagship GPT-5.6 model, with API reasoning efforts `none`, `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, and `max`: https://developers.openai.com/api/docs/models. Codex docs describe “Ultra” separately as a subagent mode, not just a model slug or ordinary reasoning effort: https://developers.openai.com/codex/models.

Recommended implementation:
1. Change Sepo’s bundled Codex default from `gpt-5.5` to `gpt-5.6-sol`.
2. Add `max` support to the Codex GPT-5 reasoning suffix handling and display logic.
3. Do not silently map `ultra` to `reasoning_effort`; add a separate config path only if Codex/ACPX exposes Ultra as a supported CLI/API setting.
4. Update docs and tests covering model defaults, resolver output, and ACPX model selection.
5. Verify with `.agent` tests: `cd .agent && npm run test:ci`.

For an immediate repo-local override, the closest currently supported policy is:

```json
{
  "providers": {
    "codex": {
      "model": "gpt-5.6-sol",
      "reasoning_effort": "max"
    }
  }
}
```

To have me make the code change, rerun this as `@sepo-agent /implement`.
